capabilities: auto-arrange selected or all Canvas cards into a grid
pick up a selected card and place it by clicking empty space
cancel a pick-up and snap the card back to its original position
fuzzy-search cards by text to select and pick up one
configure grid columns and gap spacing
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README explicitly states no dependency on Advanced Canvas despite referencing its code, and documents touch-input behavior via Pointer Events.
motivation: The author built it because moving cards had no good answer for tidying a messy board and pulling one card out of a dense cluster, and no existing plugin covered either case.
problem: On messy or densely packed Canvas boards there is no built-in way to tidy card layout or to grab one card when the drag hit-target is too small at low zoom.
summary: Canvas utility that auto-arranges cards into a grid, picks up a selected card for click-to-place placement, and finds cards by text search.
